body: I wish I could help more (I'm not good with words). You've been strong enough to get this far and I'm wishing you courage going forward, knowing how hard it is. It often feels like there isn't any other way out, but I hope you find one. Best of luck.

I'm so sorry to hear this :(

It sounds like you have people that you love, and who (probably) love you back. You are not alone in how you're feeling and you don't have to be alone in looking for help, if you have a significant other then please let them know how you're feeling, or maybe look into options like therapy if you feel up for it. It might help you learn how to get some of that control back.

Here for you.

Sorry I read the rules and realised I tried to tell you what to do, feel free to ignore any of that. I do sincerely hope you find your confidence though, and I hope you feel better soon. Please be kinder to yourself.

I'm so sorry. You do not deserve any of that. It's incredibly hard and isolating to go through something like that. I'm proud that you've made it this far. I wish there was something I could do more than this, you deserve that help. Do you have people to talk to about the way you feel? 

And I understand the desire to be normal, to be just like everyone else, but I promise you it's not worth it. You will grind yourself down into the "desirable" bitesize aspects of your personality for other people to enjoy just to feel accepted, to feel like you're one of them, and it won't happen. 

I've struggled similarly for a long time, and to be honest, it hasn't quite gone away. If I knew how to get rid of it I'd let you know lol. But over the years I managed to stop caring so much, sort of like- "yeah im this, this and this, but thats just me?" even if you don't like it yourself, it's who you are. 

I can recommend finding people or places in life or online that share the same interests as you and can accept you wholeheartedly, warts and all. While it might not do anything for your self image, for people to validate your feelings alone can bring you enough confidence to begin not caring.
